name: arp23.nucleation_reserve_fraction

Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

name: crosslink.k
source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

name: envelope.area_modulus
source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §2: unbound from membrane.area_modulus — the nuclear envelope is TWO bilayers in parallel, so K_A = 2 x the single-bilayer value. Rawicz 2000 Biophys J 79:328 (10.1016/S0006-3495(00)76295-3, SE211, audit OK; KB-3.B1.3 verified/High) K_A = 243 mN/m +/- 10 % across 12 PCs = 2.43e5 pN/um -> 4.86e5 here. This is the GLOBAL area term (assemble.py k_area -> Surfaces.k_area, g = k_area/area0 * dA), additive to the mu_2d edge network's own areal response K_A = 2 mu_2d; the membranes are slack until envelope.excess_area = 0.30 is spent, which is why the lamina (Dahl 25 mN/m) and not the bilayers sets the measured NE stiffness. The lamina's own contribution is envelope.mu_2d + the lamina population, NOT this row.

name: envelope.kappa_bend
source: BOUND 2026-09-16 21:14 at 4.0 = twice the lamina-shell estimate's top: P8s (4.0, dt 1e-4, 30 steps) read 0/0 folds and area_res 0.003/0.024/0.036 (PASS), P8q (2.0) 0/3 folds but area_res 0.887 at k=30 (fails the 0.3 line), P8p (8.3) 0.100. Earlier: PI decision 2026-09-16 18:57 (RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.3-s10.8): the nuclear envelope's bending rigidity is the LAMINA SHELL's, not a bilayer's. Shell estimate kappa = K h^2 / 12 with K = 2.5e4 pN/um (Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779, lamina 2-D modulus, audit OK) and h = 15-30 nm -> 0.5-2.0 pN.um (6-25x the bilayer's 0.083 = 20 kT that stood here until 09-16); 2.0 is the shell estimate's top. The 09-16 decade (P8m-P9c, dt 1e-4 and 1e-3) was run at the sweep point 8.3 (100x, the range's ceiling) through the launcher's spec_kappa variant; 2.0 is NOT yet verified to hold the sheet (the next 1e-4 30-step arm reads that). At 0.083 the 30 %-excess-area envelope folded within 1 ms at 1e-4 unless the fluid slaved it x100 (P8i/P8l). This row carries the lamina shell's bending share only; the lamina population (build/lamina.py) carries its own axial/bending terms.

name: envelope.mesh
source: was 0.1 um by analogy with the cortical band CEILING (world/build/envelope.ENVELOPE_MESH_PI_GAP); bound to resolution.spacing 2026-08-28 (0.096 -> 0.048 um realised, subdiv 6 -> 7, 40,962 -> 163,842 nodes) — the lamin meshwork is the coarser 0.4 um structure and is its own population

name: envelope.mu_2d
source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

name: membrane.inplane_flow_enabled
source: switch, not a material value: 1 gives every membrane face a lipid COUNT as state and lets that material move between faces along the tension difference (physics.surface_count_flow), so the face-area constraint projects onto N_f x membrane.lipid_area_per_molecule instead of the area the face was built with (area_constraint_reference = 'count'). 0 leaves the build and the step byte-identical, which is the shipped value: this changes the membrane's constitutive behaviour and the merged head still has an unexplained membrane volume-flux instability on the device (INVENTORY E21/E22) that must be resolved before the default path carries it. Without it a tether cannot form and, under plate compression, the contact zone and the free zone cannot exchange membrane, so the membrane tension is artificially non-uniform in exactly the experiment that reads cortical tension.

name: membrane.inplane_friction
source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction
source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters
source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.
